question: Can Arkansas mills custom-blend or toll-process farmer/co-op grain while preserving identity?
least_cost_repair_candidate: existing mills + aggregated producer demand + IP grain contracts / toll milling

definitions.custom_blend_mill_ingredients: Mill formulates ration from mill-sourced ingredients to farmer specs
definitions.toll_mill_farmer_grain: Farmer/co-op delivers owned grain; mill grinds/mixes/pellets for a fee; ownership of grain remains with farmer/co-op
definitions.identity_preserved_toll: Toll milling with documented segregation/cleanout/testing to protect non-GMO/organic identity

arkansas_desk_findings.note: Butterball has segregated specialty line inside captive system

regional_comparator.note: MO mills publicly advertise toll milling (e.g., NEMO Feed) — proves service class exists nearby, not AR availability

verdict_desk: NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE — toll/IP pathway must be voice-tested before any new-mill hypothesis advances
advance_new_mill_gate: Do not advance greenfield mill recommendations until LF Feeds, JA Farms, Powell, and RVO have been asked about identity-preserved toll/custom runs and refused or proven technically unable under stated conditions.
